title: ReVEL: Multi-Turn Reflective LLM-Guided Heuristic Evolution via Structured Performance Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2604.04940v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Designing effective heuristics for NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems remains challenging and often requires substantial domain expertise. Recent LLM-guided evolutionary methods have shown promise for automated heuristic generation, but most existing approaches refine heuristics independently or through limited pairwise feedback. We propose ReVEL: Multi-Turn Reflective LLM-Guided Heuristic Evolution via Structured Performance Feedback, a framework for group-wise multi-turn heuristic refinement. ReVEL organizes heuristics into behavior-aware reflective groups, including similarity-driven groups for localized refinement and diversity-driven groups for exploratory search. Within each group, the LLM performs iterative multi-turn refinement using accumulated performance feedback, enabling related heuristics to be jointly analyzed and progressively improved across evolutionary iterations. translated_title: ReVEL：基于结构化性能反馈的多轮反思式LLM引导启发式演化
translated_abstract: 为NP难的组合优化问题设计有效的启发式算法仍然具有挑战性，且通常需要大量的领域专业知识。近期基于大语言模型（LLM）引导的演化方法在自动启发式生成方面展现出潜力，但大多数现有方法都是独立地或通过有限的两两反馈来改进启发式算法。我们提出了ReVEL：基于结构化性能反馈的多轮反思式LLM引导启发式演化，这是一个分组式多轮启发式改进框架。ReVEL将启发式算法组织成行为感知的反思组，包括用于局部改进的相似性驱动组和用于探索性搜索的多样性驱动组。在每个组内，LLM利用累积的性能反馈进行迭代式多轮改进，使相关启发式算法能够被联合分析，并在演化迭代过程中逐步优化。在标准组合优化问题上的实验（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: ReVEL提出了一个分组式多轮反思框架，通过行为感知的分组（相似性驱动组与多样性驱动组）和结构化性能反馈，让LLM能够联合分析并迭代改进启发式算法，从而自动化地为NP难组合优化问题生成高质量启发式算法。
en_tdlr: ReVEL introduces a group-wise multi-turn reflective framework that organizes heuristics into behavior-aware groups (similarity-driven and diversity-driven) and leverages structured performance feedback, enabling LLMs to jointly analyze and iteratively refine heuristics for NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems.
